title: Agents almost always work under a task: a session doing real work with no task is caught and pushed to open one

requirements.text: A session that edits files with no started task gets a message telling it to open or start one
requirements.check: manual: drive a fresh session to edit a file with no task; observe the message

requirements.text: A task with no goal raises no such message
requirements.check: manual: start a goal-less task, edit a file, observe no message

requirements.text: genlock sweep prints a no-task mark for any session that has edited files without a started task
requirements.check: genlock sweep output shows the mark for that session

evidence: claude -p (haiku) in a scratch repo, app hooks from this checkout, no task: Write hello.txt -> PostToolUse context 'You are changing files with no started task... open one (genlock new ..., then genlock start ID) or start one you already have'; channel untracked.json {edits:1,file:.../hello.txt}

claude -p: genlock new 'Write bye file' --loose (goal none, T-7GYPR) + genlock start, then Write bye.txt -> model reports hook context NONE; channel holds only state.json (no nudged, no untracked.json)

tests/run.mjs 595/595 pass incl. 'sweep marks a session that edited files with no started task' -> '[+abc123] ... NO TASK: edited files with no started task (3 edits, last page.mjs, 2m ago)' + SUGGEST line, and not for tok-a whose task is in_progress

answers.observed: two real claude -p drives (reminder text quoted back; channel files listed) and the 595-check suite
answers.cause: measured: the mark is written by nudgeUntracked on Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit when no in_progress ticket is owned
answers.absence: sweep was not run against the live app store; it was exercised through the real CLI against a fixture sessions.json
answers.assumption: app sessions get this only once Genlock.app is rebuilt: the bundled genlock in /Applications still has the old nudge text; Bash-only edits (sed) nudge but do not leave the sweep mark
answers.falsify: a live app session editing with no task after rebuild showing no NO TASK line in genlock sweep

what: Genlock.app bundles its own genlock; the new nudge and sweep mark reach app sessions only after a rebuild
verify: after rebuild, an app session's Write with no task leaves untracked.json in its channel
